items.text: Added button/key prompts to the Advanced Tutorial so players can see how to complete each section.
Added an option to enable or disable the icon that appears near the blast zone.
Random map selections are now weighted more fairly, rather than giving priority to maps selected by other players.
Fixed an issue where Moon and Forest weren't included in the map rotation when selecting the Random option.
Made Basic Tutorial prompts dynamic to match the user’s selected control profile.
Added item interactions from SR1:
Freezing a running player with the Freeze Ray now preserves their momentum while sliding.
Detonating a Remote Bomb near a Fireball now pushes it in the opposite direction.
Using Shockwave near Remote Bombs now detonates them.
Fireballs can now destroy other Fireballs when colliding.
In the custom lobby, if a player accepts an in-game invite while on the rewards screen, it is observed that the reward pop-up remains on the screen instead of disappearing.

In Practice, if the player navigates through the already completed 'Basic Tutorial' and presses Select and Back at the same time, the Basic Tutorial confirmation UI appears on the Local Screen. On canceling the confirmation and navigating to Basic Tutorial again, it is observed that 'Basic Tutorial' is not functional.

In Extras, when the player presses A+Y (Xbox controller) / ✖+△ (PS controller) simultaneously while Item Glossary is highlighted, and disconnects and reconnects the controller on the Item Glossary screen, it is observed that the game becomes stuck in a loop and keeps switching between the Item Glossary and Profile screens. Additionally, screens keep switching on when the Back button is pressed, as the Select Button becomes non-functional.
In Ranked Match and Quick Match, if the user turns off the Crossplay Setting and then joins a Ranked Match or Quick Match, the user can join the multiplayer session.

In Menus, if a player selects PLAY to start the Tournament, the Local and Practice tabs delay disabling for approximately 2 seconds, allowing the player to select Local and start the campaign within that time frame. Eventually, the game remains in a perpetual loading state after completing Act 1 of the campaign.
If the player tries to climb the platform at the top-right of the 'SS Royale B' map and runs to the right, they go out of bounds and fail to return.
If the player tries to climb the platform at the top-left of the 'SS Royale' map and runs to the left, they go out of bounds and fail to return.
If the user unassigns the key for the Use Pick Up function, a white placeholder image appears next to the power-up during gameplay.
Gameplay
Stun duration now adjusts based on the player's position. Players further behind receive significantly shorter stuns, up to 60% reduction for the last-place runner.
Fixed cases where the second player becomes last while inside the blast zone, incorrectly knocking out the incorrect player.
Restarting a local or campaign match now correctly resets the blastzone.
Online
Reduced the lobby countdown timers for Ranked (FFA) to 25s, and Ranked 1v1 to 15s.
UI
Fixed the character 3D models' resolution inside the dialogue boxes featured in cutscenes.
Faster main menu transitions in the main menu.
Audio
RedZone music now starts correctly when restarting a match.
Progression/Achievements
Steam now retroactively unlocks the tutorial achievements if you had met the requirements when playing the beta before the game's release.
Fixed an issue affecting players with Windows usernames that contain the underscore character, which reset their progress every time they closed the game.
• Added a setting to turn off other players’ trails.
• When joining a crossplay private lobby with the setting turned off, the game will now tell you that crossplay is not enabled.
• Adjusted the Shockwave's hitbox to match the animation.
• Removed the timer from custom lobbies.
• Fixed the Slope Surf exploit that allowed players to use Taunts.
• Fixed typos in the Crate’s description in the Glossary.
• Fixed an issue where the Opponent Outlines setting was unintentionally disabled.

releases.displayName: Patch: 1v1 Ranked, Outline Customization, Pickup Balancing, Fixes

items.text: Added option to customize Outline Color: Max Contrast (Current Default), and Player HUD (outline color based on the player HUD color)
Added option to customize Online Outline: Only Me (show only my outline), All Players (show all players' outlines)
Added option to customize the Opponents Outline color in online gameplay: Default (based on the Outline Color option), All Red (show all opponents in a red outline)
Made it easier to dodge (like the Golden Hook).
Reduced stun time.
Reduced the knockback amount when hit.
Reduced the freeze time duration.
Increased matchmaking time to wait for more players.
🏃Added a warning "!" icon indicator when players are close to being KO'd by the blast zone.
🏃Added a blinking animation on the boost bar when being used.
🏃Added the tutorial incentive prompt asking players to play the tutorial first if they wanted, when attempting to play any game mode.
🏃Improved the visual representation of the max players allowed in a custom lobby when there are bots added.
Fixed Report Tool soft-locking players when used in the middle of a match.
Fixed the Edit Controls button not working with the keyboard.
Fixed V-Sync option capping to 60 fps on game launch, when the setting is off.
Fixed Bots not using the Drill item enough.
Fixed low-res image for the stages selected by other players online.
Fixed low-res Start button on local character select.
⚠️An important note about the crossplay feature availability in the Nintendo Switch version:

We have no choice but to delay the release of Patch 1.4 on Nintendo Switch. Because of this, crossplay will be temporarily unavailable on that platform until the patch is rolled out for the Switch players. We expect it to happen somewhere next week, if everything goes smoothly. Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience! Crossplay between Steam, Xbox, and PlayStation is unaffected.
Hey everyone!
Hope you enjoyed our new trailer and caught the news about us revealing the release time window (it would be July 2026 for Steam and all consoles! )

notes.title: We also just updated a demo. Here is the changelog

items.text: General fixes for infinite loading, online stability, and players not spawning.

Added a new reporting tool where you can submit your feedback and bugs. Please find it on the right side of the main menu under Submit Report, as well as under the Pause Menu during gameplay.: This tool will automatically send your player save and log files, as well as a screenshot of the game, when you submit a report, which will greatly help us during our investigation. Please use that button!
Added a button to kill bots in local matches, usable when all real players have been KO'd. This button will appear in the bottom-right corner when the last living player is KO'd.
Please update the demo in your Steam library.
If you have detailed thoughts/ideas to share about the Demo, feel free to fill in this survey.
Optimized the Out VFX stutter when a player hits the blast zone.
Fixed default audio setting for VO set to 0.
Fixed a localization issue in Spanish.
Fixed mouse navigation on the player count selector when creating a lobby.
Customization menu scroll fixes.
Experience gain in the Tournament mode now displays the correct number at the end.
Fixed local mode rewards not showing after a tournament.
Please update the demo in your Steam library.
If you have thoughts/ideas to share about the Demo, feel free to fill in this survey.

According to player feedback, speed and acceleration have been decreased compared to the "Gotta Go Faster" patch; all pickups have been balanced accordingly. Speed and acceleration are still higher than they were in the pre-patch version of the Demo.

After listening to your legendary feedback on the Demo, we've adjusted the game's movement system - it should feel much faster now! Acceleration has been increased - this applies to running on the ground, being in the air, using boost, entering wind tunnels, and, most importantly, when swinging using the grappling hook. All pickups have been balanced accordingly.

Gravity and fall speed have also been turned up. which should help with getting that "floaty" feeling some of you have reported. That said, we made sure not to increase this aspect too much to prevent situations where you can't maneuver in the air because the gravity is too high.
Apart from that, we've fixed multiplayer bugs where players wouldn't load into a match, and the matchmaking timer would get stuck at "00:00." We applied fixes to game states that caused these bugs.
Update the demo in your Steam library.
Please let us know what you think about these changes to the movement system! Feel free to fill in this feedback survey or drop your take on the forums/our official Discord.

Before we delve into the details of the first patch we introduced for the Demo, our team wants to say an enormous "Thank you" to everybody who's tried the game so far! We read all feedback that you share, and it helps us BIG TIME to improve SpeedRunners 2.
Now, about the freshly released patch. Here's what's included in it:
Fixed cases where players would spawn alone in Online mode. (We're currently double-checking this to make sure the bug doesn't recur.)
Fixed cases where the matchmaking timer wouldn’t progress. (We're currently double-checking this to make sure the bug doesn't recur.)
Fixed issues when a player disconnects on the level select screen in Online mode.
Moved Practice mode into its own tab in the main menu.
Fixed the fireball getting stuck in SS Royale.
Fixed the selected Controller Profile not loading after restarting the game.
Fixed the announcer not saying the Speedrunner’s name on the results screen.
Fixed Change Skin buttons not updating correctly when switching between keyboard and gamepad.
Please update the demo in your Steam library.
If you have thoughts/ideas to share about the Demo, feel free to fill in this survey.

releases.displayName: Release ETA Update; Open Playtest Overview

items.text: When will SpeedRunners 2 be released?
Community's favorite character has been revealed! Who may that be?

Sam's setback becomes one of the Open Playtest's highlights! Who tf's Sam anyway?: Find the answers below!👇: First off, huge thanks to everyone who took part in the Open Playtest in September! During that event, we had almost 70,000 unique players, and many of you shared valuable feedback that'll, zero doubt, help us make a more kickass game.: That said, we have an announcement to make. Based on the playtest's results, we decided to take a bit more time with SR 2 and move the release to next year.
We’ll announce the exact locked date later—keep your eyes peeled for future updates on that, speedrunners!

With the release date news out of the way, let's have a look at some interesting insights from our Open Playtest Feedback Survey. These insights should give you a better idea of why we decided to postpone the launch slightly. BTW, around 2,000 people filled the survey out—a big "Thank you" to everybody who did that. 🤝

If you need proof that the SpeedRunners community is the best out there, look no further than this image below. We asked you to share "the most memorable moment you experienced so far"—some of the replies turned out to be pure gems.
Hopefully, Sam gets their revenge soon. And that guy's friend, too. It's not over yet!
So, who were the most selected characters during the playtest? Cosmonaut Comrade takes the win with 24% of players choosing to run as him. Maneki Neko is a close second, followed by Speedrunner.
Next up, here are the top 5 SpeedRunners 1 characters whose comebacks the community anticipates the most. SkullDuggery beat Falcon by a tenth of a percent!💀
Just a heads-up, we're already working on some of these folks! Check out this guy's outfits:
Here are some teasers of what's to come in the map department:

notes.title: 📊SOME BORING NUMBERS📊 (You should read this, though)

items.text: About 97% of participants have played the first title. On one hand, it’s rad to see the community being so passionate about the series. On the other hand, though, it means there are still many newcomers to bring in who aren't aware of SpeedRunners. Needless to say, we’ll be putting effort into marketing, and next time I'll ask you to invite your friends who haven’t played before!

Around 75% of the player base prefer playing with friends, and approximately 20% prefer online play. Still, two-thirds of those folks in the first group are also interested in jumping into the online modes every now and then.

The survey summary contains some positive comments about the game's setting, maps, level design (especially, the brand-new Museum map), voiceovers, UI, and performance. Visibility is among the weaker points—a lot of work still needs to be done in that area. Expect more effort to also be put into the netcode (to address that input delay) and performance. The extra time we're taking due to the launch delay will be of use to us in this regard.

The replies in our feedback form also show positive input on increasing the number of players in a match to 8. Love yourselves some chaos occasionally, eh? Our team is set to improve the mode according to the feedback we've got on it—e.g., modifiers for playing in a party with friends.

notes.title: Aaand the key finding from the survey was...

items.text: ...the fact that the majority of players who've participated in the Open Playtest are excited to check the game out when it ships. However, many are choosing to wait for improvements and then see if it's worth playing—and we’re committed to delivering those improvements, rest assured. If you want to learn more about the near-future plan our crew has outlined for ourselves, read this post right here.

Anyway, folks, thank you again to everybody who jumped into the Open Playtest to check it out. I'll let you know as soon as I get any news from my team on what's next for SpeedRunners 2 and when's that release date gonna be revealed. We hear all the feedback coming our way and have some stuff in store for you. The next playtest will occur once we’ve changed the game enough so that you can notice substantial progress! So, stay tuned and...
Be fast or be last!
Wishlist the game and follow our Steam page to keep up with the latest news.
